1. Place a Table to satisfy the “Place Table” achievement.
2. Turn to a Tree and “Do” to collect Wood (Collect Wood).
3. Turn to a Stone and “Do” to gather it (Collect Stone).
4. Place the Stone in front (Place Stone achievement).
5. Place a Furnace (Place Furnace achievement).
6. With the table, craft a Stone Pickaxe (Make Stone Pickaxe).
7. Use the stone pickaxe to mine Iron Ore and Coal (Collect Iron, Collect Coal).
8. Use the Furnace to smelt Iron Ore into Ingots.
9. Use table and furnace to craft an Iron Pickaxe and Iron Sword (Make Iron Pickaxe, Make Iron Sword).
10. Locate enemies (Zombie, Skeleton) and “Do” to defeat them (Defeat Zombie, Defeat Skeleton).
11. Find and eat a Cow (Eat Cow).
12. Find a lake and “Do” to drink (Collect Drink).
13. Seek out a Sampling block and “Do” to gather it (Collect Sampling).
14. Mine a Diamond block (Collect Diamond).
15. When energy is low, perform Sleep to recover (Sleep, Wake Up).
16. Verify all 22 achievements are completed, then continue playing or exit.
